profile.summary: KPI Green Energy Limited operates as an independent power producer that focuses on the development, construction, ownership, operation, and maintenance of renewable energy projects under the Solarism brand name in India. The company operates through the Sale of Power & Plant and Sale of Plots segments. It also operates as a captive power producer that offers customized renewable energy solutions.
